    Manage it yourself, any time

    Your online account puts bills, Direct Debit, tickets and your contract documents in one place — no waiting on hold.

    • View and download invoices
    • Check Direct Debit status

    • Download your Contract Summary

    04Straight answers

    Frequently Asked Questions

    View all FAQs

    Pay by Direct Debit for automatic payments each month, or by bank transfer to OCCTA LIMITED (Lloyds Bank, sort code 30-98-97, account 61499362) quoting your OCCTA account number. We do not take card or phone payments.

    Only once your service is confirmed live. Monthly charges are then billed in advance on your billing date. Your first invoice may include a pro-rata amount and any one-off charges from your Contract Summary.

    Sign in to your account and open Billing. Every invoice is available to view and download as a PDF.

    Sign in, open Billing and set up a Direct Debit mandate, or use the secure link we email you. To change bank, set up a new mandate and let us know. Until a mandate is confirmed active, pay invoices by bank transfer.

    We'll email you. Pay that invoice by bank transfer, quoting your account number. If money is tight, contact us early and we'll talk through a payment arrangement.

    A £10 late-payment administration charge may apply only after an overdue notice and a reasonable opportunity to pay, and never repeatedly on the same invoice.

    No. OCCTA residential contracts don't include scheduled CPI-, RPI-, inflation-linked or percentage-based price rises. Price Lock 24 keeps your broadband price fixed for the 24-month minimum term.

    Contact us with your preferred day of the month and we'll tell you whether it can be moved and how it's pro-rated.

    Raise a billing ticket with the invoice number and what looks wrong. If a Direct Debit was taken in error, you're also protected by the Direct Debit Guarantee. We won't restrict service over an amount that's genuinely disputed.

    Approved refunds are returned by bank transfer to the paying account, or applied as a credit to your next invoice if you prefer.
    05Personal help, tracked

    Support Tickets

    For faults, billing queries and anything that needs investigating. Every ticket gets a reference, a full history and updates by email.

    • Include your account number and service address
    • Say when it started and what you've tried
    • Add wired speed tests for speed issues
    • Tell us if anyone relies on the line for health or safety

    Need Personalised Help?
